answer: Mitigating Ridge Registry.** Each identity must continuously hold a distinct position on a physical ridge of scarce licensed radio spectrum, verified by periodic triangulated beacons. Colluding identities face a timber limit: only so many adjacent slots may share one transmitter origin, and slot reassignment follows a spiral audit trail logged by independent monitors. An attacker's cost is acquiring and maintaining genuinely separated transmitter sites with real power and licensing, which cannot be cheaply duplicated per fake identity.
